create.description: Name the customer company. End users invited with an address of its e-mail domains join it.

members.title: Members
members.description: End users of the customer company. A person belongs to one organization at most.
members.empty: The organization has no members yet.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.archiveDescription: The organization becomes read-only until it is unarchived. Its e-mail domains stay reserved.
danger.unarchiveDescription: The organization can be changed again.
danger.deleteDescription: Deletes the organization with its e-mail domains, project access and memberships. The accounts of the members stay. This cannot be undone.

setup.title: Set up Trybun
setup.intro: Create the first Administrator account. You set up two-factor authentication when you sign in for the first time.
setup.invalidTitle: This setup link is invalid or has expired
setup.invalidText: Run <command>./trybun setup-token</command> on the server for a new link.
setup.passwordDescription: At least {min} characters. A phrase of several words is easy to remember. You sign in with this password and a one-time code from an authenticator app.
setup.systemDefaults: Default language of the system: {language}; default time zone: {timeZone}. Both are set in <file>.env</file> and changed there, followed by <command>docker compose up -d --wait</command>.
setup.doneText: Sign in with your e-mail address and password. Trybun then asks you to set up two-factor authentication with an authenticator app.
